comment: Go struct and interface names being defined, like `config` in `type config struct` or `Hasher` in `type Hasher interface`, including generic and grouped `type ( ... )` declarations. The builtin grammar uses the same `entity.name.type.go` scope for definitions and usages, so this rule scopes these names as `entity.name.type.struct.go` and `entity.name.type.interface.go`. Other definitions like `type Set []interface{}` or `type ID = string` stay uncolored, same as type usages.

name.comment: Struct or interface type name, with optional type parameters: `Pair[K comparable, V any] struct`, but not `Set []interface{}` or `Arr [4]struct{}`

patterns.comment: `type Name[T any] struct`, same as the builtin generic `single_type` rule
`type ( Name struct; ... )`, same as the builtin `multi_types` rule
